name: mcap-gripper-quadtile-raw
description: MCAP gripper rig, mosaic published raw as /quad_tile sensor_msgs/Image (express_raw)
_comment: FREQUENTLY TUNED: the video block below; an explicit CLI flag always wins.
Identical to mcap-gripper-quadtile except for the camera topic. Both spellings
of the mosaic exist in the recorded corpus -- /quad_tile carries raw Image and
/quad_tile/compressed carries JPEG -- and picking the wrong one used to mean
hand-editing the shared profile before every batch. The override lives here so
the profile stays a description of the robot rather than of one batch.
notes: state_tolerance_periods is 2.0 here against 1.5 for the compressed recipe, and
that difference is the whole reason these are two recipes rather than one topic
override. A raw mosaic frame is ~5 MB, so writing it blocks the recorder and the
receive times of everything else go bursty -- and lerobot-loop alignment reads
receive time, not header.stamp. Measured on express_raw: /joint_states is clean
(100 Hz, zero drops, 10.4 ms max gap) yet the age of the newest sample before a
camera tick reaches p99 16.0 ms / max 17.1 ms, so the 15 ms default rejected
41 of 1103 rows. 20 ms clears it with headroom while staying far tighter than
the db3 recipes' 45 ms. Re-measure before widening it further: past ~2.5 periods
the bound stops describing jitter and starts hiding real dropouts.
The mosaic topic itself does drop frames (~2.6% estimated on express_raw), which
'rdp check-rosbag' reports as a WARN. That is a recording-side problem; widening
